author: IGN
description:
Mortal Kombat 1 might have "1" in the title, but NetherRealm’s latest entry has grown into a massive behemoth since its 2023 debut. From the multiversal madness of the Khaos Reigns expansion to the arrival of pop-culture icons like Homelander and the T-1000, the "New Era" timeline has seen a total overhaul of its roster and mechanics. We’re breaking down every Kombatant, Kameo, and secret Pink Ninja Floyd encounter that has hit the arena since launch.

Whether you're looking for a recap of Kombat Pack 1 and Kombat Pack 2 or curious about the return of Animalities and the Towers of Time, this comprehensive guide covers all the major DLC and free updates. We dive into the gameplay shifts brought by the Definitive Edition, the addition of crossplay and cross-progression, and the controversial history of those holiday-themed premium fatalities. Stay up to date on the current state of Mortal Kombat 1 balance changes and the evolving meta of assist-centric 2D fighting.

#ign #gaming
title: Mortal Kombat 1 - Everything Added Since Launch

Zero Parades: For Dead Spies is the spiritual successor to Disco Elysium, and the team at ZA/UM is looking to capture lightning in a bottle twice with their espionage-focused followup. The drama that happened at the development studio is way too deep to dive into in this video, but I do want to show you the biggest gameplay differences between Zero Parades and its predecessor.

author: IGN
description:
Making a video game is hard enough, but the journey of the modern Hitman trilogy is nothing short of a miracle. From its rocky start as an episodic experiment under Square Enix to IO Interactive’s daring leap into independence, Agent 47 has survived layoffs, publisher splits, and a complete technical overhaul. Today, the World of Assassination stands as a massive, interconnected stealth epic that somehow balances three games' worth of content, a grueling roguelite mode, and cross-platform progression into one definitive package. We’re breaking down the wild history of how this trilogy evolved from a single level in Paris to a sprawling platform that paved the way for IO’s upcoming 007 project.

In this deep dive, we explore every major update and expansion added to the Hitman trilogy since its 2016 debut. We cover the transition from Hitman 1’s episodic releases to the feature-heavy Hitman 2 and the VR-compatible Hitman 3. Learn about the addition of Freelancer Mode, the implementatio
title: Hitman - Everything Added Since Launch

description:
Subnautica 2 might offer some cozy moments of coral reef exploration and base building, but the deep ocean still hides its most terrifying secrets. The Collector Leviathan is the newest nightmare waiting to turn your exploration into a fight for survival. This massive squid-like predator guards the crucial gap between the starting area and the resource-rich late-game zones, acting as a deadly gatekeeper for any unprepared diver. If you're looking to face your fears—or just trying to make it to the other side in one piece—we’ve got the exact location and the strategies you need to survive her crushing grip.

This Subnautica 2 gameplay guide breaks down everything you need to know about navigating the trench east of the starting life pod to encounter the Collector Leviathan. We go over the specific biomes you'll pass through, including the dangerous volcanic geysers, and provide a step-by-step tutorial on crafting the Tadpole vehicle. title: Subnautica 2: How to Find (and Survive) the Collector Leviathan
